name: Calves Wilson
role: Early priest sent to preach in the West
dateNote: Section 75 called him to preach on 25 January 1832 at Amherst, Ohio.
importance: Section 75 pairs him with Asa Dodds and sends them to preach in the “western countries”. Little else is known of him. One modern biography says he was baptized and ordained a priest in October 1831. It suggests he may have gone with Lyman Wight to Cincinnati in 1832, but that is not documented.
connections: Called with Asa Dodds at the Amherst conference.

sources.title: Calves Wilson, Doctrine and Covenants Central

reviewNote: No JSP person page found (the guessed URL returned an empty page). Doctrine and Covenants Central (Susan Easton Black) gives no birth or death data and says his later life is unknown. Baptism and ordination details are from that biography only.
